# Gaussian Action Readout: opt-in pi0.5 path at 2.11 times the ten-step teacher speed on one L4 proof

## Ticket Type

💡 Feature Request / Improvement

## Description

pi0.5 samples actions with a ten-step Euler integrator. [Gaussian Distillation of Flow Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40271) (Youssef Saied, Ziyad Sheebaelhamd, Claire Vernade, and François Fleuret, 29 October 2026) proposes a Gaussian Action Readout. The readout replaces the final action sampling of a frozen flow policy with one Gaussian head. The paper says code will be released soon. This proposal does not import an unreleased official repository.

Proposal: an opt-in `gaussian_readout_path` on `PI05Config`. The default is `None`, and the ten-step Euler sampler stays in place. A set path loads a separate readout artifact and samples from it. The readout is a sibling module, `src/lerobot/policies/pi05/gaussian_readout.py`. The proof runner is `experiments/gar/proof.py`.

### Speed test

One NVIDIA L4, `lerobot/pi05_libero_finetuned_v044` at revision `7152f13e34c6c115d808aea0e5d08aca74eac14b`, 8 held-out contexts, 20 passes, 160 samples per path. The job is https://huggingface.co/jobs/hadriencornier/6ae5343e0e0338d1bb7cfb64. It finished at 7:39 PM CDT on 30 October 2026.

| Path | Median seconds | p95 seconds |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Ten-step teacher | 0.3119816809994518 | 0.32245491800131276 |
| Gaussian readout | 0.14764849000130198 | 0.1528457519998483 |
| One-step teacher, diagnostic | 0.1494976560024952 | 0.15267175000190036 |

The teacher median divided by the readout median is 2.1130028556113287. The prefix medians are 0.12027883799964911 seconds for the teacher and 0.12623716599773616 seconds for the readout. The action-network medians are 0.19028417899971828 seconds for the teacher and 0.019946808999520727 seconds for the readout. Held-out mean squared error on the same 8 contexts is 0.013512860052287579.

### Simulation

LIBERO-Long task "put both the alphabet soup and the tomato sauce in the basket". Initial states 0 and 1. Policy seeds 17, 18, 19, and 20. Sixteen episodes, eight pairs.

The teacher succeeded on 8 of 8 episodes. The readout succeeded on 8 of 8 episodes. Every success used the soup-then-sauce order. The two-mode label is inconclusive, because that label requires the teacher to succeed in both orders.

### Limits

- The timing sample is one L4 and 8 held-out contexts. It does not rank a controller. No real arm was used.
- The simulation is one task, one checkpoint, two initial states, and four seeds.
- The two-mode result is inconclusive on this slice. This proof does not show that the readout keeps both teacher orders.
- The one-step teacher row is a diagnostic. The comparison in the proposal is the ten-step teacher.
- The paper's larger fitting protocol, and its reported Xiaomi and GR00T results, are outside this proof.
- An earlier L4 job, https://huggingface.co/jobs/hadriencornier/6ae52eaf0e0338d1bb7cf942, matched this held-out mean squared error and a speed ratio of 2.1006753076003957, then stopped before any episode.

## Context & Reproduction

Implementation and evidence: https://github.com/huggingface/lerobot/pull/5174

The branch is `Hadrien-Cornier:fm/lerobot-gaussian-readout`, based on `724b1b62ff41ed6ada55d5157b51101f52011cd6`. A merge with current `main` is clean.

## Checklist

- [x] I have searched existing tickets to ensure this isn't a duplicate.
- [ ] I am using the latest version of the `main` branch.
- [ ] I have verified this is not an environment-specific problem.

## Additional Info / Workarounds

The branch pin is `724b1b62ff41ed6ada55d5157b51101f52011cd6`. The measured proof commit is `973b159ad2c20aaddba9983abef59dc3d845361f`. Commit `728cbfe49a3385aa1856f936472d848bc371ec92` only marks two bandit sites in the proof runner. `gaussian_readout_path` stays unset unless a caller supplies an artifact.
